Senior Software Engineer
Location: Vilnius or Kaunas (Office-Based/Hybrid)

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve core components of iModel Cloud Sync Services. This role focuses on developing reliable, scalable cloud services that ingest, transform, and synchronize engineering data from diverse sources into the iTwin platform.
As a Senior Engineer, you will work hands‑on with distributed systems and cloud‑native technologies, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate closely with product managers, architects, and other engineers to deliver robust, production‑grade solutions.

Software Design & Development
Design, implement, and maintain cloud‑based synchronization and ETL services that transform engineering data into iModels.
Build distributed, event‑driven, and task‑oriented systems using microservices, messaging, and containerized workloads.
Contribute to the design of workflow orchestration mechanisms, including state‑driven execution, retries, and long‑running tasks.
Develop services that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements for global, multi‑tenant deployments.
Cloud Platform & Distributed Systems
Implement microservices and data pipelines using Azure, Kubernetes, containers, and cloud‑native primitives.
Follow best practices for CI/CD, zero‑downtime deployments, configuration management, and secret handling.
Implement concurrency control, idempotency, and conflict‑resolution patterns in distributed workflows.
Build and maintain observability features, including structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerts.
Data & ETL Workflows
Develop ETL pipelines for parsing, validation, transformation, and mapping of engineering data formats.
Implement schema management and versioning strategies for synchronization workflows.
Ensure pipelines support deterministic execution, fault tolerance, and transactional consistency.
Reliability & Operational Excellence
Implement resilience patterns such as retries, backoff strategies, circuit breakers, and rate limiting.
Participate in design and code reviews with a focus on maintainability, security, and operational readiness.
Help diagnose production issues and contribute to root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement.
Collaboration & Technical Growth
Collaborate with architects and principal engineers on design and implementation decisions.
Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best practices.
Contribute to shared engineering standards, documentation, and technical knowledge bases.

Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
7+ years of professional experience in software engineering with exposure to distributed or cloud based systems.
Strong experience with Azure, microservices, containers, and Kubernetes.
Hands on experience building ETL pipelines, workflow based systems, or event driven architectures.
Proficiency in one or more languages such as C#.
Solid understanding of observability, CI/CD, reliability, and cloud operations.
Strong problem solving skills and the ability to deliver production quality software.

ORDERYOYO Senior Software Engineer – Payments Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary About the Role At OrderYOYO , payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Payments to help us build a more resilient, scalable, and compliant payments operating model — across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — across a rapidly growing, international restaurant platform.

Role Mission Own and evolve OrderYOYO 's payments capabilities — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

Core Responsibilities Design, build, and operate payment-domain services, including gateway integrations and payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.
Implement marketplace capabilities where relevant: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.
Build robust “flow-of-funds” primitives — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails — that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.
Integrate with PSP and partner tooling, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.
Implement dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and collaborate with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.
Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.
Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain through automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements — and mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and contribute to shared standards and documentation. Payments is too critical to be tribal knowledge.
Must-Have Requirements Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.
Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.
A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.
Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.
Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.
Strong-to-Have Experience Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).
Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.
Who We Are At OrderYOYO , company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build.

Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve. We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business.

By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably. Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe. What We Offer
· Competitive salary. A remote role — work from wherever you do your best work, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

· High ownership and autonomy. Clear progression toward Tech Lead / Staff Engineer responsibilities.
The opportunity to work on revenue-critical production systems.
A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.
A collaborative, international engineering team.
Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and long-term growth.

Variant Security is securing the world's critical fleets for the AI era. Nearly every device runs identical software, so a single exploit can cascade across an entire fleet, and AI has made finding that exploit cheaper than ever. Variant breaks that pattern, so compromising one device gives an attacker nothing against the rest. AI made exploits cheap. We make them useless.
We're building our engineering team in Bochum. As a working student you're part of that team from day one, doing real work on the product, not intern busywork, with room to go deep on compilers and binary security if that's your thing.
Tasks
We have more tasks than hands. Tell us where you'd start.
Build internal tooling and automation, mostly in Python and modern C++
Extend our testing and CI infrastructure around the compiler
Evaluate hardened binaries for correctness, performance, and security impact
Integrate our technology into build and deployment workflows
Go deeper into compiler internals, if you bring the background

You're deep into a Bachelor's or working on a Master's in computer science, IT security, or a related field.
Solid programming skills, ideally in Python or modern C++
Curiosity for binaries, compilers, and how systems break
Self-organized and reliable, you follow through and ask sharp questions
CTFs, reverse engineering, systems security, or related coursework earn bonus points.

Get paid to work on compilers, binaries, and exploits while you study
Learn directly from a founding team with deep security, compiler, and space-systems pedigree (top-tier security research, DARPA, SpaceX)
Your code ends up protecting real fleets across aerospace and defense
Fair pay, and hours that flex around lectures and exam season
A real shot at a full-time role after graduation
We're looking for builders, hackers, and systems thinkers. If this sounds like you, apply.
Johannes Willbold
Co-Founder & CEO

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant-ici.
La-Direction de la Transformation Numérique et de l-Intelligence Augmentée (DTN-IA)-créée, intègre et gère toutes les applications informatiques-d'un-des-systèmes d'information hospitalier les plus performants afin de soutenir les activités cliniques et logistiques des Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève.

Avec un parc de plus de 12'500 postes, 1'300 serveurs pour plus de 250 applications au service de l'ensemble du personnel, disponible 24h/24h et 7j/7j, la DTN-IA gère un système d'information RH pour les 13'000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs des HUG et des 7 autres institutions genevoises et un ERP performant pour les processus logistiques et financiers des plus complexes.-
La DTN-IA-crée-un dossier patient informatisé à la pointe du secteur et participe au rayonnement des HUG grâce à une richesse fonctionnelle reconnue et des collaborations étroites avec tous les professionnels et professionnelles de santé et leurs directions transverses. Par ailleurs, la DTN-IA intègre des équipements biomédicaux de pointe et du quotidien ainsi que des applications spécialisées pour tous les plateaux médico-techniques.-
Le métier de la DTN-IA est de soutenir les activités quotidiennes et de bâtir le futur d'un hôpital moderne et performant, selon les axes stratégiques de l'institution en s'appuyant sur les meilleures pratiques et les standards les plus exigeants.-
## Description du poste ##
Intégrez et renforcez une équipe composée de 2 développeurs fullstack et un lead développeur, dont la mission est de poursuivre le développement et l-évolution de l-application Greco, le logiciel de gestion de planning et de téléconsultation utilisé par le personnel.

Le logiciel est également utilisé par les patients et patientes grâce à l-application Concerto. L-équipe travaille de manière agile en s-inspirant fortement de la méthodologie Scrum tout en s-adaptant aux contraintes liées au milieu hospitalier qui impliquent d-être capable de parfois devoir changer rapidement de tâche pour s-adapter aux priorités.
Vous participez à la rédaction des cahiers des charges techniques, en traduisant les besoins fonctionnels en spécifications détaillées. À partir des spécifications techniques, vous développez le logiciel, aussi bien sur la partie front-end que back-end, en utilisant les technologies de pointe et une architecture microservices.

Vous faites évoluer la solution et garantissez sa maintenance, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux. Concrètement, vous développez en autonomie les fonctionnalités et corrections qui vous sont attribuées.
Grâce à votre esprit d-équipe, vous collaborez étroitement avec l-équipe pour développer des solutions et des fonctionnalités fiables et évolutives. Vous partagez les meilleures pratiques et adoptez une approche critique et constructive dans une optique d-amélioration continue en faisant preuve d-une forte orientation solution.
Tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, grâce à votre sens de la communication, vous contribuez au développement du logiciel de manière optimale et structurée, assurant un lien essentiel avec les coordinateurs et coordinatrices greco des différents départements médicaux.

Vous adaptez votre langage en fonction de vos interlocuteurs et interlocutrices pour vulgariser les termes techniques, challengez les solutions proposées, et collaborez activement avec les parties prenantes pour trouver les adaptations les plus pertinentes.
De plus, vous veillez à la mise à jour et à la rédaction de la documentation nécessaire. Vous mettez à profit votre capacité de synthèse et votre pragmatisme pour mener votre mission dans les délais impartis et garantir un résultat de qualité.
Vous participez activement à l-ensemble des phases d'un projet informatique, de son initialisation à sa finalisation, en vous assurant de produire les livrables attendus à chacune de ces phases. En outre, vous assurez également le support utilisateurs de niveau 3, en relation avec les autres services de la DTN-IA, tout en assurant une orientation client forte.

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en informatique ou d'un diplôme jugé équivalent, et vous justifiez d-une expérience d-au moins cinq ans dans une fonction de développement fullstack en contact avec le métier.
Vous maîtrisez une architecture microservices avec les technologies Java/J2EE avec le Framework Spring, en particulier Spring Boot, Spring Data r2dbc, Spring cloud stream et Spring Security, mais également OAuth2, Hibernate et SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL). Vous avez effectué de nombreux tests unitaires et d'intégration, avec les outils de test Junit5 et Mockito. Une connaissance de l-architecture microservices orienté évènement avec la solution Kafka constitue un atout important.
Pour la partie frontend, vous détenez une expertise sur Angular avec la version 20 idéalement.
Vous savez utiliser les outils de collaboration (GIT, JIRA et Confluence) ainsi que les outils de construction Maven et Docker. Une connaissance approfondie des méthodes agiles, notamment Scrum, constitue un atout.
Vous faites preuve d-une excellente capacité relationnelle dans les environnements pluridisciplinaires, alliant communication, vulgarisation des termes techniques et écoute active pour garantir la compréhension des besoins.
Vous savez prendre du recul et tirer parti des retours d'expérience pour progresser. Votre sens de l-initiative est un atout précieux pour le développement de solutions innovantes.
Vous faites preuve d-organisation, d-un bon sens relationnel et d-autonomie dans la recherche de solutions. Par ailleurs, vous avez démontré votre capacité d-initiative et vous souhaitez relever des défis dans un environnement exigeant et de grande technicité.

Redpanda is the first runtime and control plane for agent-data interaction — a unified platform that combines streaming, SQL analytics, and intelligent connectivity with the governance layer enterprise AI agents need in production.
Built on infrastructure already trusted by Fortune 500 companies and fast-growing startups, Redpanda enforces governance entirely outside the agent's data path, controlling what agents see, limiting what they do, and capturing a tamper-proof record of everything they touch, so organizations never have to choose between innovation and control.

Redpanda is building the Agentic Data Plane (ADP) — the streaming and data infrastructure the world’s largest enterprises run mission-critical agents on. The enterprises winning right now are building agents that encode their own business logic, their own data, their own institutional knowledge into production-grade infrastructure. That’s digital sovereignty, and Redpanda ADP is the infrastructure layer that makes it real.
Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is the delivery arm. We embed engineers directly with strategic customers and build the agents and integrations that turn ADP into owned outcomes. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the builder: embedded on-site, working inside the customer’s environment, writing the code that ships.
This is not a solutions engineering role. You are not here to demo or advise. You are here to build — agents, integrations, data pipelines, and the infrastructure that runs them — alongside a customer team, in their environment, on their timeline.

Build at the customer site. Write production-quality agents, integrations, and data pipelines on Redpanda ADP, inside the customer’s environment and codebase. What you ship has to work after you leave.
Work in unfamiliar territory, fast. Every customer engagement is a new codebase, a new data environment, a new set of constraints. Ramp quickly, orient to what exists, build on top of it without breaking it.
Own the technical deliverable. Understand what the engagement is supposed to produce, design the technical approach, build it, and hand it off clean — documented, maintainable, and running in production.
Be the Redpanda technical voice with the customer’s engineers. Work alongside their team daily. Earn their trust. Make sure the work integrates correctly with what they already have and what they’ll maintain after you leave.
Drive toward exit from day one. Build with handoff in mind. Write documentation that their team can actually use. Train them on what you built. Don’t create dependencies on you.
Feed learnings back. Identify patterns across engagements — what customers keep needing to build, where ADP makes things hard, what should be productized. Bring that back to Product and Engineering clearly.

Engineering depth. You write production software. You’ve built backend systems, data pipelines, APIs, or agent systems that ran in production and had real consequences when they broke. Language background is flexible; what matters is that you build things that work.
Agent and integration experience. You’ve built agents, worked with LLM APIs, or built integrations between complex systems. You know what makes an agent reliable vs. brittle, and you’ve made that call in production.
Ability to operate in any environment. You’ve worked in someone else’s codebase, with constraints you didn’t set, in a stack you didn’t choose. You can read unfamiliar code, understand what it does, and extend it without breaking it.
Customer-facing communication. You can work directly with a customer’s engineering team — their leads, their architects, their individual contributors — and be a credible, trusted technical partner. You don’t need a PM to translate for you.
Shipped at a customer site or in a deployment context. You’ve personally been in the room when something hard went live. You know the difference between a demo and a production deployment.

Experience in a forward-deployed or customer-embedded engineering model — Anthropic FDE, OpenAI Deployed Engineer, Stripe FDE, Sierra, Palantir FDSE, or analogous.
Background in streaming or real-time data systems (Kafka, Flink, Redpanda, or similar).
Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector) or air-gapped environments.
Have been the first or only technical person in a customer engagement — run it end-to-end without a playbook.

Reports to: Head of FDE
Travel: 30–50% during active engagements; lighter between engagements. You’ll be on-site when the build is live.

Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.
With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.
Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.
This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.

s.h: On a day-to-day basis, you will
s.t:
Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.
Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.
Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.
Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.
Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.
Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.
This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.

We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.
You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.
This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.

The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.
The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.

Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.
Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.
Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.
Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.
A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.
Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).
Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.
Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.

At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our in-house engineering team builds and runs every product we operate. We work in two product teams, iGaming and Rewards, supported by platform and infrastructure engineers. We are partway through building a new version of our platform, which makes this the right moment to put quality engineering at the heart of how we deliver.
You will lead quality engineering across both product teams. You will guide how we test, build the frameworks and pipelines that make testing fast, and help every engineer take ownership of the quality of their own work.
This is a hands-on technical role. Early on you will write a lot of the framework code yourself. Over time your influence will come through the tooling you build and the engineers you coach.

Define our test strategy: what we test at unit, integration, contract and end-to-end level, so every team knows where a given test belongs and why.
Build and own our automation framework in Playwright and TypeScript, covering web front ends and APIs across both product teams.
Make CI feedback fast and trustworthy.
Bring our existing end-to-end suite to a healthy state and keep it there as the new platform grows.
Coach developers to write and own tests for their own code, through pairing, code review and clear examples.
Set up test data and environments that let teams test realistically and safely.
Introduce performance and load testing for our core applications.
Work with product managers so acceptance criteria are testable before build starts, and so testing time is part of every estimate.
Track a small set of quality measures, such as escaped defects, change failure rate, suite run time and flake rate, and use them to decide where to invest next.

Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, with test code written to the same standard as production code.
Deep experience with a modern browser automation framework. Playwright is ideal; Cypress experience transfers well (we’re in the process of migrating from Cypress to Playwright).
A track record of designing test strategy across the full testing pyramid for web products and APIs, including judging where automation earns its keep.
Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions ideally) with Docker, and fixing pipelines that are slow or unreliable.
Evidence of raising quality through other people, whether by coaching developers, setting standards or leading a quality practice.

Contract testing in a service-based architecture, for example with Pact.
Performance and load testing with k6, Artillery or similar.
Using AI coding assistants to speed up writing and maintaining tests, with the judgement to review what they produce.
Using observability data and production signals to decide what to test.
Visual regression or accessibility testing.
Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health.
How you work
You explain quality trade-offs to product managers and business stakeholders in plain terms.
You will hold a release back when the evidence says it is not ready, and then help the team find a safe way to ship.
You write things down: strategies, decisions and guides other engineers can pick up and follow.
You are comfortable shaping a practice from an early stage, where you will need to decide what matters most first.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Elliptic's Product-Engineering organisation, focusing on data engineering solutions that power our blockchain analytics and intelligence products. Challenges include building a blockchain-agnostic solution that scales globally, processing large batch and streaming datasets, and solving complex data processing problems that give our customers deep insights into the flow of value across the crypto ecosystem.
Elliptic is building an AI fluent workforce. We invest in the tools, training and time for our teams to use AI well: every Elliptite has access to Claude, and we expect AI to be a normal part of how you work, not an occasional add on. We are not looking for people who use AI the most. We are looking for people who use it best, with curiosity, sound judgment and full ownership of what they ship.
Across our Product, Engineering, Design and Intelligence we’re going beyond giving everyone the tools. We’re setting new standards. Using AI to transform how we build and work every day to deliver on our market opportunity. Put another way our teams iterate alongside agentic systems applying judgement to build world class systems.
What that looks like for this role is set out below.

Our data and intelligence platform sits at the heart of everything we do. As a senior engineer, you will personally design and build data systems that serve as the backbone of all Elliptic products. By collaborating across blockchain, intelligence and product teams, you will deliver innovative features that help the world fight financial crime and increase transparency in the crypto space. Very few engineering roles have such clearly measurable real-world impact.
You will also help us excel in engineering excellence by mentoring and upskilling our highly-engaged and passionate engineers, by championing best practices, and holding yourself and your team to a high standard.

Contribute to platform-wide initiatives that improve reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.
Help shape the technical roadmap for data engineering across Elliptic.
This role requires ‘Adoptive’ AI fluency. This means AI has already changed how you work, not just how fast. We expect you to enjoy leveraging AI and agentic systems to operate more effectively.
